# Legacy 1.6 kit fixtures

Content files of 1.6.1 mockup kits, frozen before the 1.7 engine changes (taken from the v1.6.1
templates): a classic kit, a continuous kit with a kit-defined object type (`custom-objects.js`)
and a licensed photo object (the photo is generated by the test), and a kit whose `brand` sets only
`bg1`, so the 1.6 fallback colours fill the rest. `tests/store-render.test.sh` renders each with the
v1.6.1 scripts (from `git archive v1.6.1`) and with the current scripts, and compares decoded pixels.
